scope: Full-text review of the two previously abstract-only environment/curriculum candidates; no broad discovery.

candidates.access_depth: Full primary PDF methods, experiments, tables, and appendices; no experiment reproduction or identified code/data release.
candidates.shortlist_recommendation: Do not displace a stronger top-ten evidence family. Use as first reserve for the missing autonomous environment/curriculum mechanism; include only if replacing the weakest redundant framing source for coverage balance.

relevance.reason: Persistent policy updates are driven by automatically mined environments, fresh tasks, failure diagnosis, and targeted curriculum generation.

evidence.reason: Broad external evaluation and stated eight-run averaging, weakened by no dispersion, unknown benchmark subsets, private SFT data/harness, unmatched resources, absent decontamination, and a Table 2 numerical inconsistency.

novelty.reason: Combines large-scale executable environment mining with repeated diagnosis-guided RL.

teaching.reason: Distinct example of environment/curriculum co-evolution and of why fresh generated tasks are not untouched tests.

coverage.reason: Fills autonomous environment and curriculum generation missing from the leading evidence families.

decisive_results: Table 1: Agent-World-8B reports 8.9 MCP-Mark, 51.4 BFCL V4, and 61.8 tau-squared-Bench versus EnvScaler-8B at 5.6, 47.6, and 37.9.
Table 2: two targeted rounds rise monotonically for Agent-World-14B and EnvScaler-8B, but the prose conflicts with the table on tau-squared-Bench values.
Environment sweep average rises 18.4% to 38.5%, without holding generated data or compute constant.
main_limits: No matched token, trajectory, GPU-hour, wall-time, or dollar budget across methods or rounds.
Eight repeats are stated without standard deviations, intervals, tests, or per-run data.
Some external benchmarks use unspecified sampled subsets; no contamination or overlap audit is reported.
Private 40K Doubao-generated SFT trajectories, in-house harness, and no identified release limit reproducibility.
candidates.copy_status: Temporary v1 PDF inspected; not retained because the arXiv license does not establish third-party redistribution permission.

candidates.access_depth: Full primary PDF methods, experiments, tables, prompts, and input-processing appendix; no experiment reproduction or identified code/data release.
candidates.shortlist_recommendation: Do not replace a current top-ten family. Retain below Agent-World as an adjacent proactive-context example; persistent memory/task-stream sources provide stronger coverage of lasting improvement.

relevance.reason: A learned fixed policy proactively generates website-specific context, but deployment does not update weights or accumulate persistent cross-environment knowledge.

evidence.reason: Useful no-context, base-prompt, teacher-prompt, SFT, and RFT comparisons on 1,427 tasks; weakened by unverifiable website separation, no stochastic uncertainty, LLM judges, and sparse training/resource detail.

novelty.reason: Outcome-selected training for task-free inference-time exploration is distinctive, though the resulting artifact is external Markdown context.

teaching.reason: Shows both benefits of trained environment maps and harms from noisy self-generated context.

coverage.reason: Adds proactive world mapping but overlaps memory/context adaptation rather than filling weight-level RSI.

decisive_results: Qwen3-30B rises from 22.04% to 40.91% on WebWalker and 41.08% to 57.44% on WebVoyager with the RFT guidebook policy.
Seed-OSS-36B rises from 16.26% to 37.50% on WebWalker and 39.93% to 56.79% on WebVoyager.
Untrained prompt-only guidebooks can underperform no guidebook, supporting a quality rather than mere extra-context effect.
main_limits: The 20 training websites and full evaluation website/item lists are not disclosed, so environment-level separation is not auditable.
No seeds, repeated guidebook generations, intervals, or significance tests despite stochastic generation.
Guidebook-generation cost is excluded from the claimed 17% task-step efficiency gain.
RFT candidate count, training hyperparameters, hardware, token totals, wall time, and cost are not reported.
candidates.copy_status: Temporary v1 PDF inspected and validated; not retained. CC BY 4.0 permits sharing with attribution.

overall_decision: Neither should displace a strong controlled or longitudinal source. Agent-World is the preferred reviewed reserve and the representative if the final set needs explicit autonomous environment/curriculum generation.
